title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31656v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for meta-reinforcement learning. It decomposes the fast adaptation phase into two temporal scales: a causal neural memory performs fine-grained within-episode adaptation with linear sequence complexity, while compact episode-level summaries support long-range cross-episode task inference without attending over the full interaction history. translated_title: METTA：面向元强化学习的记忆增强测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 元强化学习旨在训练能够从有限的交互中快速适应未见任务的智能体，但这需要在长交互历史中对任务证据进行表示。经典的循环神经网络智能体将经验压缩到隐藏状态中，而基于Transformer的智能体则以二次方的内存和计算开销从过往轨迹中检索信息。在本工作中，我们提出了面向元强化学习的记忆增强测试时自适应方法（METTA）。该方法将快速适应阶段分解为两个时间尺度：因果神经记忆以线性序列复杂度执行片段内的细粒度自适应，而紧凑的片段级摘要则支持长程的跨片段任务推断，无需对完整的交互历史进行注意力计算。此外，为智能体配备神经记忆提供了足够的表达能力与测试时训练能力，使其能够有效适应未见的保留任务，并……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出METTA方法，将元强化学习的快速适应分解为片段内的因果神经记忆细粒度自适应与跨片段的紧凑摘要级任务推断两个时间尺度，以线性序列复杂度实现了对未见任务的高效测试时适应。
en_tdlr: METTA decomposes fast adaptation in meta-reinforcement learning into within-episode fine-grained adaptation via causal neural memory and cross-episode task inference via compact episode-level summaries, achieving efficient test-time adaptation to unseen tasks with linear sequence complexity.
